paragraphs: He is mentioned in Yalkut Shmuel, remez 118; so it is cited in Otzar Yisrael, but he is not found in our Yalkut.[^1]

notes.text: קיח explicitly gives remez 118. Yalkut Shmuel and Otzar Yisrael remain the supplied work names without an independently identified edition or expansion to Yalkut Shimoni. In is an English syntactic supplement to נזכר ילקוט. Not found in our Yalkut reports Hyman’s negative observation, not a fresh cross-edition search. The sole personal-title abbreviation remains R'; transliteration is harmonized to the English title without a source-name change.
